_comment: Detached garage behind 37 Temple St (the stucco house 248288899 is 2 m off face -v). Gable end to Temple St (+u), ridge along u. Tan vinyl siding, slate-blue trim and fascia, grey shingle roof with wide eaves. +u: one white sectional door left of centre, and the right ~2.8 m (the -v side) is an open carport under the same roof, caricatured as a dark open bay. Other faces plain (no openings visible).
